issue.title: Add retry policy for outbound webhooks
issue.body: Retry failed outbound webhook events with bounded backoff. Duplicate delivery must not create duplicate business actions. Describe timeout and dead-letter handling.

analysis.summary: Make webhook dispatch retryable without duplicate side effects.
analysis.proposed_change: Introduce bounded retries, idempotent delivery identification and failure reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Transient failures trigger bounded retry attempts.
Duplicate deliveries do not duplicate business actions.

tests.expected: Delivery succeeds after retry within policy limits
No duplicate business action is performed

analysis.reasoning: The model considered this routine but independent reliability controls may raise risk.
